description: Search for Jira issues using JQL. Supports complex queries with pagination and field selection. Examples: "project = PROJECT AND status = Open", "assignee = currentUser()". For pagination, use nextPageToken from previous response.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

nextPageToken.description: Token for pagination. Omit for first page, use value from previous response for next page.

name: jira_search_issues
